content: BACTRIM is a synthetic antibacterial medication that combines two active ingredients: sulfamethoxazole and trimethoprim. It is available in two forms: double strength (DS) tablets, which contain 800 mg of sulfamethoxazole and 160 mg of trimethoprim, and standard tablets, which contain 400 mg of sulfamethoxazole and 80 mg of trimethoprim. Both formulations are intended for oral administration. Sulfamethoxazole is chemically known as N1-(5-methyl-3-isoxazolyl)sulfanilamide. Its molecular formula is C10H11N3O3S, and it has a molecular weight of 253.28. The compound is nearly white in color, odorless, and tasteless. Its structural formula is provided in the original description. Trimethoprim is chemically identified as 2,4-diamino-5-(3,4,5-trimethoxybenzyl)pyrimidine. Its molecular formula is C14H18N4O3, and it has a molecular weight of 290.3. This compound ranges in color from white to light yellow, is odorless, and has a bitter taste. Its structural formula is also included in the original description. The inactive ingredients in the formulation include docusate sodium (85%), sodium benzoate (15%), sodium starch glycolate, magnesium stearate, and pregelatinized starch.
